result.summary:
Re-gated docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-028.md (branch feature/WF02-REQ-028, commit 7f3d785) against the specific BLOCKING finding recorded in the prior FAIL (handoffs/WF02-REQ-028/step-03b-test-design-validator.json): the spec and its Step 3 handoff narrated apps/bot/src/handlers/checkin.forgery.test.ts as an already-committed file containing 5 new vitest cases, when the file did not (and still does not) exist.

Read core-directives.md and WF-02 Step 3b. Diffed the rework myself: `git show 7f3d785 -- docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-028.md` shows every passage that previously asserted or implied the file already exists rewritten to correctly frame it as a design for TEST-RUNNER to implement and commit at Step 4 -- 'for a second, new test file this spec designs ... this file does not exist yet' (Independence note, lines 16-25), 'for the new test file this spec designs (not yet written)' (tg_id range, lines 50-51), 'TEST-RUNNER writes and commits the new test file at Step 4 ... (does not exist yet)' (Shared setup step 6, lines 77-88), and each of the 5 case sections now opens with 'New `it(...)`, designed here for TEST-RUNNER to write in the new (not yet written) test file' (AC1 line 95, AC3 line 145, AC4 line 180, cross-event forgery line 215, concurrent double-toggle line 268) in place of the prior 'New `it(...)` in the new committed file'. `git show 7f3d785 -- handoffs/WF02-REQ-028/step-03-test-designer.json` shows the matching correction in TEST-DESIGNER's own handoff summary: 'THIS FILE DOES NOT EXIST YET ... TEST-DESIGNER writes the markdown design only; TEST-RUNNER writes and commits the actual vitest file at Step 4', citing the same REQ-026/REQ-027 precedent this gate's prior FAIL raised as a role-boundary question.

Independently confirmed, not taken on the rework's word: (1) `git log --all --oneline -- apps/bot/src/handlers/checkin.forgery.test.ts` returns nothing -- the file genuinely does not exist anywhere in history, which is now correctly what the spec says rather than contradicting. (2) Ran my own `grep -n -i "already.*committed|already exist|confirmed via|new committed file"` over the current spec: the only 'confirmed via' hits left are line 13 (BACKEND-DEV's checkin.db.test.ts, which genuinely IS committed -- correctly claimed and previously verified) and line 57 (the tg_id-range grep against EXISTING files, not the unwritten one). No remaining false already-exists claim anywhere in the document. (3) `grep -in TODO` on the spec: zero matches.

Confirmed the actual test-case designs are unchanged from my first-pass review (already validated sound then): re-read AC1's page-turn interleaving (12-attendee/2-page fixture, stale admission change surviving an intervening page-turn re-render), AC3's no-profiles-row fixture, AC4's 4-point counter sequence (0/3->1/3->2/3->1/3) with full-row events deep-equality, the cross-event forged-toggle case (exact notAuthorized alert text, audit-row entityId check), and the concurrent double-toggle case (exact checkedInAt===null final state, exactly-one-of-each audit row count). Substance is byte-for-byte identical to the version I confirmed sound before FAILing solely on the false-existence framing -- only the framing language changed, per `git show 7f3d785` above. Coverage table (lines 327-342) and AC2/AC5/AC6 deferral to BACKEND-DEV's committed checkin.db.test.ts are also unchanged and remain correct.

Re-checking the three gate criteria: (a) every acceptance criterion has >=1 verification case -- AC1/AC3/AC4/cross-event-forgery/concurrent-toggle each have one, AC2/AC5/AC6 correctly deferred to BACKEND-DEV's already-committed cases -- PASS. (b) no TODO left -- PASS (zero matches). (c) each case precise enough to run without judgment -- PASS: every case names the exact fixture, exact dispatch sequence (real bot.handleUpdate() calls with concrete callback_data), and exact pass/fail assertions (exact catalog strings, exact audit_log predicates, exact counter values) -- these are runnable specifications, not vague 'looks right' checks, and now correctly say the vehicle for running them (checkin.forgery.test.ts) is still to be written by TEST-RUNNER rather than falsely claiming it already exists.

PASS. The prior BLOCKING issue is resolved at the source (spec and handoff text corrected, no design content altered). The prior MINOR role-boundary flag is also resolved: the rework adopts the REQ-026/REQ-027 precedent explicitly (TEST-DESIGNER designs, TEST-RUNNER writes and commits), removing the ambiguity rather than leaving it open.

checks.every_ac_has_a_case: PASS -- AC1/AC3/AC4/cross-event-forgery/concurrent-toggle each have a described, precise case; AC2/AC5/AC6 correctly deferred to BACKEND-DEV's already-committed checkin.db.test.ts.
checks.no_todo_left: PASS -- grep -in TODO on the current spec: zero matches.
checks.cases_precise_and_runnable: PASS -- every case names exact fixture, exact dispatch sequence, exact pass/fail assertions, and now correctly states the vehicle file does not exist yet and will be written by TEST-RUNNER at Step 4, matching the confirmed REQ-026/REQ-027 precedent. No case claims to already be executable code.
checks.false_existence_claims_removed: PASS -- git show 7f3d785 confirms every passage previously asserting or implying apps/bot/src/handlers/checkin.forgery.test.ts already exists (Independence note, tg_id-range note, Shared setup step 6, all 5 case openers) is rewritten to state plainly it does not exist yet and is TEST-RUNNER's Step 4 deliverable. git log --all -- that path independently confirms the file still does not exist, consistent with the corrected text.
checks.test_case_substance_unchanged: PASS -- re-read all 5 case designs (AC1 page-turn interleaving, AC3 no-profiles-row fixture, AC4 counter sequence, cross-event forged-toggle, concurrent double-toggle); substance matches what was already confirmed sound in the first-pass review, only the framing language around file-existence changed.
